compliment: A 4.8 across 48 Google reviews, and a customer on your own site calling Craig and the team "prompt, professional and thorough", says the service side is right.
gap: The website isn't keeping up. On a phone it opens as a desktop layout that's wider than the screen, so the heading and menu run off the right-hand side, the phone number can't be tapped to call, and the footer still says ©2021.
pitch_line: It leads with interlock and landscape construction, lays out the maintenance and snow work clearly, and fits a phone with a tap-to-call button.
